plan.rationale: A one-man general repairs and small renovation business needs a page that reads as capable and no-nonsense, not corporate. I stripped every unverifiable claim (15+ years, guarantees, suburb list beyond what was given) and kept only what was actually said: the service categories, the Pretoria base, the no-unfinished-jobs commitment. Bold-industrial with technical-sans suits a trade page. Layouts vary between wide-rows, cards and steps so the page does not feel templated, with one deep band on the commitment section since that is the strongest real idea here.
